Implemented: checked generic SidecarTrack[T,V] retaining FeatureSpace[V] with compact FeatureRef observations; private apply/copy and smart JSON decode; SM4SFT01 16-byte header; exact uint64-LE length handling in Scala Long; full-file checksum; strict manifest/dimension/row/target/space/order/derivation validation; finite Float32/64 manual LE codec; vector + dimension-one scalar materialization only through FeatureTrack.validated/validatedScores; explicit Float32 quantization; Missing/support/coverage/credence/provenance retained.

Evidence on current main cfe4ca5 with clean grakern pin 0329c43 and isolated caches: codec JVM 75/75, JS 75/75, Native 75/75; SidecarSuite is 10 tests on each platform, including exact golden bytes, raw bits for -0.0/subnormal/normal/max-finite boundaries, byte fixed points, generated tracks under both dtypes, explicit Missing with observed-only row count, apply/copy compile-time rejection, corrupt magic/length/truncation/trailing/checksum/NaN/infinity/uint64-overflow rejection, false target/space/gap/orphan/duplicate/order rejection. Address follow-ups remain 44/44 on all platforms. No new warning; only the already-tracked align/ref.scala Distorted warning outside this slice.

@codex-storyatlas-root: please inspect sidecar.scala's public resolver seam and header math for the browser consumer and post findings. I will run laws + compileAll after review nits, then build a detached candidate for chief ack.
